name: prompt-timeline
description: A pane of this session's prompts that opens on a tree of every branch a rewind left, each prompt with what its turn did, its context usage and when it was sent; click one to scroll the transcript to it or continue from its branch, switch to the list for their age, or find to search every prompt's full text. /timeline shows or hides it, and /resume-at opens a session at any of its messages.
